optimizedContext.value:
# Indexer

## Rules

- IndexCodeGraph discovers workspaces/resources, diffs hashes/fingerprints, extracts Pass 1, resolves Pass 2, indexes specs with SpecRepository/GetSpecMetadata, bulk persists and records ref/observations.
- Fingerprint: code-graph version + canonical workspace hash. Fingerprint/backend mismatch causes provider recreate() full rebuild with reason.
- Discovery merges include/exclude/allowed paths/gitignore and excludes spec root from docs. Decode UTF-8/UTF-16LE/UTF-16BE/Windows-1252 sans NUL; filter binaries.
- Pass 1 all workspaces: FileAnalysis, DEFINES/EXPORTS. Then Pass 2 from in-memory facts only: IMPORTS, CALLS, CONSTRUCTS, USES_TYPE, EXTENDS, IMPLEMENTS, OVERRIDES; deterministic, no self/unresolved/store queries.
- Specs: repo.list(), metadata fingerprint, optimizedDescription-preferred title/description, coverage/DEPENDS_ON. One bulkLoad(), then rebuildFtsIndexes().
- Package resolution via LanguageAdapter.getPackageIdentity. onProgress 0–100; per-file errors collected, infrastructure faults abort. IndexResult returns counts/errors/duration/workspaces/ref/fingerprint/rebuild fields.

## Constraints

- Store pre-opened; indexer no lifecycle/backend ownership.
- Forward-slash paths; supplied excludePaths replaces defaults; gitignore priority.
- No language rules here; specs exclusively SpecRepository.
